integrity: All claims are supported by a self-contained argument and standalone finite consistency checks; neither external peer review nor independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact inclusions are restricted to products of simplices and the intrinsic difference-body gauge; the all-segment/cube case is previously treated; the high-dimensional crossover is asymptotic. Earlier unindexed tensor-product results remain a priority risk. The 2007 simplex article could not be inspected beyond its abstract.
title: Sharp radial mean-body envelopes of Cartesian products of simplices
